hypothesis: M2 improves missing-ball spell but increases false D cuts under dropout; increase both entering/exiting D costs by4 when either adjacent frame lacks ball observations, retaining existing Home/Alive probabilities and team cost.
inputs: exact cached out-of-match M2 probabilities for J03WPY/J03WOH/J03WQQ; no model refit or label input
mechanism: one fixed factor4, no search; visibility only; per-half reset; missing never forces either alive or dead
comparison: M2 fixed decoder vs M2 plus missing-stability; natural must be bitwise unchanged
retention: experimental only if dropout full-spell improves >=2/3 matches and mean delta >=0.01, false-dead cut counts do not increase on any match, and natural predictions identical; otherwise revert
validation_status: post-hoc hypothesis based on previous development results, preregistered before this ablation; same development folds, not a fresh test
